correctness.rationale: The displayed stationary densities pi_+=pi_-=1/[2L(1+R)], pi0=gamma/[L delta(1+R)] solve all forward balance equations. The periodic harmonic coordinate F_s=x+h+s*g, with g=v/(alpha+G), h'=(gamma-G)/(alpha+G), has zero generator; its jump bracket averages to 2*v^2/[(alpha+G)(1+R)] under ergodicity. Bounded corrector and bounded-jump martingale CLT transfer the diffusive limit and asymptotic variance to X_t. The Monge swap (gamma1-gamma2)*(1/delta1-1/delta2)<=0 proves comonotone minimization of R and countermonotone maximization, extended by bounded approximation. Independently checked algebra and two-zone ratio 4/3; mesh-based script was inspected but its claimed test count is not proof of the continuum result.
